verifiedFacts.fact: The National Credit Act regulates consumer credit and responsible credit granting.

The published credit-life regulation sets a maximum prescribed cost of R4.50 per R1,000 of deferred amount per month for other credit agreements; production must verify amendments/current applicability.

FSPs, key individuals and representatives are subject to fit-and-proper requirements including competence, qualifications, regulatory exams, product/class training, CPD, operational ability and financial soundness.

POPIA is based on conditions for lawful processing including accountability, lawfulness, minimality, purpose specification, further-processing limitation, information quality, openness and security safeguards.
Prior authorisation can be required for specified high-risk processing, including certain unique-identifier linking, credit reporting and specified cross-border transfers.
DMPR published September 2026 fuel-price adjustments effective 2 September 2026; use the official schedule by fuel grade and region in production.
WesBank explains a balloon as a lump-sum amount due at the end of the term; larger balloons reduce preceding instalments but remain payable.
WesBank states formal finance decisions consider affordability and creditworthiness; meeting basic application requirements does not guarantee approval.
Private motor insurance is not generally compulsory by statute, but financiers may require comprehensive cover contractually.

verifiedFacts.fact: Insurers price using their own risk models; age, driving history, claims, location, vehicle, use, mileage, cover and excess can affect premiums.

openItems: Current prescribed NCA fee caps and interest ceilings must be loaded from the latest regulations before live quoting.
Provider-specific fee schedules, balloon limits, age/term matrices and settlement rules must be contract/product-version records, not universal constants.
Live finance and insurance quote APIs require provider agreements; public web pages are not equivalent to API access.
Insurance product wording, exclusions, excess annexures and benefit limits must be versioned and source-linked.
POPIA retention schedules should be mapped by data category and legal/contractual obligation; do not use a universal five-year rule.
If VECTORI moves from information/calculation to regulated financial advice or intermediary activity, the operating/licensing model must be reviewed with the FSCA and appropriate partners.
